display.summary: Patch beta: forms save once, personal column eye controls, faster PDF opening, and clearer, faster backup browsing.
highlights: Save changes in the unsaved-changes prompt submits the form once instead of twice.
Arrange columns shows an eye on each header to show or hide it; the inspector is gone.
The PDF viewer downloads a file once, and reopening a record revalidates instead of downloading it again.
New projects get Composer wrapper 5: ./start.sh update refreshes the deployer first, ./start.sh update self updates only the deployer.
The backup viewer shows loading progress, uses faster password derivation and cached deep pages, and keeps your current view when older requests finish.
